svg.aria-label: auto-compact, drawn as a machine. Cards are entries in the context window, standing in a trough with a percent ruler. Turns add cards until the stack reaches 80%. A gantry head then reads the older cards, a small press beside the trough squeezes copies of them into one summary card while new cards keep arriving, and when the turn ends the gantry lifts the ready summary into the front of the trough, the old cards leave, and the most recent cards slide up behind it.

g.text: 80% · A SECOND MODEL READS THE OLD TURNS
IT SUMMARIZES WHILE THE SESSION RUNS ON
TURN ENDS · THE READY SUMMARY SWAPS IN
